# PR #4048: Patch: the tutorial says five lanes, and its hero health figures come from the engine's constants

Closes #4020

The tutorial no longer teaches stale numbers. The Playing-units rule counts the board's real lanes through `LANES.length`, and the Hero-health rule plus the basics lesson's welcome and hero steps fill `HERO_HEALTH` and `AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth` through `t(english, params)`, in English and Chinese. - [discoveries.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-4020/apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts): `Discovery` gains optional `params`. The play-unit rule is now `"a unit you play stands in one of your {lanes} lanes until it dies."` with `params: { lanes: LANES.length }`; the hero-health rule is `"a hero at 0 health loses. Yours starts at {yours}, the tutorial's enemy at {enemy}."` with `params: { yours: HERO_HEALTH, enemy: AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH }`.

- [steps.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-4020/apps/web/src/tutorial/steps.ts): `Common` gains optional `params`, which flows onto steps via the existing spreads.
- [basics.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-4020/apps/web/src/tutorial/scripts/basics.ts): welcome and hero texts use `{enemy}` with `params: { enemy: AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH }`.

- [zh-CN.json](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-4020/apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json): the 4 old keys replaced by the 4 `{lanes}`/`{yours}`/`{enemy}` keys with matching Chinese translations.
